title: ALJP: An Arabic Legal Judgment Prediction in Personal Status Cases Using Machine Learning Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical application of machine learning (SVM, LSTM, BiLSTM) to predict legal outcomes in Saudi Arabian family law. While the legal domain (personal status cases) in Saudi Arabia is based on Sharia law, the research benchmarks model performance on legal prediction tasks rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical beliefs or frameworks themselves.
